baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence joins faith at word 2 to the twice-stated settling of hearts at words 3-4 and 10-11.
baseline_models.mechanism: Trustful assent supplies a secure orientation, remembrance supplies the recurring contact, and the otherwise turnable interior comes to rest; the second clause expands the first group's experience into a general heart-mechanism.

activation_trace.role: Security and trusted repose make faith the condition from which settling can occur.
Inward assent makes belief a reception the heart can rely upon rather than a bare label.
Repose after agitation supplies the repeated result predicated of the hearts.
The capacity to turn from one face to another explains why the interior needs recurrent stabilization.

changed_reading.before: Believers feel calm when they remember God.
changed_reading.after: Trustful assent and repeated divine remembrance stabilize an interior that remains capable of turning, and the doubled clause presents this as a repeatable heart-process rather than a passing mood.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction repeats remembrance of God at words 5-6 and 8-9 while also repeating the settling predicate and its heart-subject.
baseline_models.mechanism: Remembrance re-presents what can recede from attention; the mirrored wording performs that return a second time, so tranquility emerges as maintained presence rather than one completed recollection.

activation_trace.role: Recovery after lapse makes remembrance a renewing operation on attention.
A reminder that makes something present again explains the verse's enacted repetition.
A reversible interior gives the repeated reminder a functional need.
Renewed repose is the recurrent output of renewed presence.

changed_reading.before: Remembrance is a devotional topic associated with calm.
changed_reading.after: The verse itself stages a maintenance loop: what may leave attention is made present again, and each re-presentation resets the turnable heart toward repose.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated noun of remembrance is immediately governed by the repeated divine name at words 5-6 and 8-9.
baseline_models.mechanism: A live co-reading takes remembrance as voiced naming: articulation makes the divine name present to the hearer and speaker, while the heart receives the settling effect.

activation_trace.role: Mention on the tongue supplies an audible or articulated mode for remembrance.
The divine name as uttered address gives the articulation a specific relational object.
The inward faculty remains the recipient even when the mediating act is vocal.
Settling links the voiced act to an inward result without reducing one to the other.

changed_reading.before: The remembrance is necessarily silent, private cognition.
changed_reading.after: Voiced naming is a coexisting possibility: the tongue reintroduces the divine name and the heart settles through hearing and articulating it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding guidance toward God for one who returns activates the focus heart's turnability: tranquility is not immobility but a repeatedly restored direction, with remembrance functioning as the return cue.

activation_trace.role: Gentle direction toward a true path supplies the vector into which the heart settles.
Customary return makes turning back a repeatable practice rather than a single arrival.
The alternate mapped branch sharpens the image into recurrent return to one place or direction.
The focus heart's reversibility provides the moving element that can be redirected.
Recollection after lapse supplies the recurrent corrective action.
Repose names the stable orientation achieved at each return.

structural_cues: 13:27 ends with the returning person and 13:28 immediately names believers whose hearts settle.
Within 13:28, both remembrance and settling recur, matching a restoration cycle rather than a once-only state.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gentle guidance, habitual and repeated return, a reversible heart, and recurring remembrance; I supply the arrow that each recollection restores orientation. A live alternative is that return describes an initiating conversion while remembrance maintains what follows.

changed_reading.before: Tranquility is a stationary condition reached after guidance.
changed_reading.after: Tranquility is dynamic fidelity: a turnable heart repeatedly returns to its Godward bearing when remembrance re-presents that direction.

context_deltas.mechanism: Fear and hope are paired under a storm scene whose thunder branch carries disturbance; against that background, the focus's repose becomes an ordering container for opposed arousal, not the erasure of arousal.

activation_trace.role: Anticipatory fear supplies one live pole of the heart's activation.
Heartfelt hope supplies the opposite pole held beside fear.
Motion and disturbance materialize the volatility within which orientation must hold.
The inward faculty is the shared site in which fear, hope, and repose can coexist.
Settling supplies organization after or amid disturbance rather than emotional blankness.
Recollection gives opposed affects a stable referent around which to organize.

structural_cues: 13:12 places fear and hope in one clause before heavy clouds, and 13:13 follows with thunder and shocks.
13:28 repeats the settling predication instead of denying the volatile states already displayed.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed heart-affects, disturbance, and focus repose; I infer that remembrance contains and orders them. The alternative is a chronological transition from storm-like agitation to later calm, not coexistence.

changed_reading.before: A tranquil heart no longer feels fear, hope, or disturbance.
changed_reading.after: A tranquil heart can remain affectively alive: remembrance gives fear and hope a common orientation and prevents disturbance from becoming disintegration.

context_deltas.mechanism: The failed call and the hand extended toward water that never reaches the mouth create a contact test. The focus's repeated naming of God then reads as relational remembrance whose object is reachable and whose effect reaches the heart.

activation_trace.role: Vocal calling establishes remembrance as potentially relational address rather than self-contained technique.
A reply to speech supplies the response relation explicitly absent from the failed calls.
The extended hand embodies an attempt to make contact.
The asking hand sharpens the image of need reaching outward for satisfaction.
Arrival at an endpoint supplies the success criterion that the water simile negates.
Articulated mention allows the focus act to answer the context's calling frame.
The repeated divine name specifies whom the remembering address reaches toward.
Heart-repose is the inward evidence that contact has not remained futile extension.

structural_cues: 13:14 contrasts the true call with calls that receive no answer.
Its hand-water-mouth comparison repeats reaching language while denying arrival; 13:28 twice names the object of remembrance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies call, nonresponse, outward extension, failed arrival, and the focus's named object; I infer that heart-settling marks effective relational contact. The alternative is only a contrast among objects of invocation, with no claim about inner contact mechanics.

changed_reading.before: Any repetitive remembering technique could produce the same calm.
changed_reading.after: The focus specifies relational direction: remembrance settles because it repeatedly reaches toward the named divine addressee, unlike an outward call that never arrives.

context_deltas.mechanism: The measured stream carries floating excess away while benefit remains. Applied to the reversible heart, remembrance does not freeze mental flow; it sorts transient agitation from what deserves durable residence.

activation_trace.role: Flow supplies ongoing inner movement rather than a static container.
A bounded measure gives each channel a capacity and keeps the filtering image proportionate.
Floating froth supplies the conspicuous but nonretained layer of disturbance.
Benefit identifies the content worth retaining after the sorting process.
Stable remaining with delay supplies the material analogue for tranquility.
The turnable heart is the focus container in which transient and durable contents compete.
Recollection reintroduces the criterion by which passing agitation is sorted.
Repose becomes durable retention rather than cessation of all flow.

structural_cues: 13:17 explicitly contrasts what departs with what benefits people and remains in the earth.
The stream runs according to capacities, so persistence is selective rather than indiscriminate blockage.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies flow, measure, froth, benefit, and remaining; I map that material sequence onto attention and supply the arrow that remembrance performs the sorting. The live alternative is that the analogy concerns truth and falsehood only, with psychological transfer remaining secondary.

changed_reading.before: Tranquility means stopping the stream of thoughts and feelings.
changed_reading.after: Tranquility can be selective persistence: thoughts and affects continue to move, but remembrance lets froth-like agitation pass while useful orientation remains.

context_deltas.mechanism: The keep-and-connect versus break-and-cut sequence activates remembrance's dormant right-document branch. Divine remembrance can therefore be carried as an interior covenantal record that secures relations and obligations, not only as affective recollection.

activation_trace.role: Repeated preservation over time turns covenant into an active practice of memory.
A protected pact trusted by its bearer supplies the social object held in remembrance.
Confirmed covenant gives the remembered obligation binding force.
Unbroken succession makes kept connection the covenant's enacted form.
Unmaking a tightly built bond supplies the exact failure that covenantal remembrance prevents.
Severed connection supplies the social consequence of losing the binding record.
The focus branch of a right-bearing document supplies the latent legal sense activated by the covenant sequence.
Security and trust explain why a kept covenantal record can settle its bearer.
Repose becomes the interior consequence of binding continuity rather than sentiment alone.

structural_cues: 13:20 and 13:25 mirror keeping versus undoing the same covenant.
13:21 and 13:25 mirror joining versus cutting what is commanded to be joined, placing the focus after a social topology of continuity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a document branch inside focus remembrance plus preserved covenant, binding, connection, undoing, and severance; I infer that the remembered divine claim functions like an interior covenant record. The dominant alternative remains ordinary recollection, with legal imagery only enriching its durability.

changed_reading.before: Divine remembrance is private recollection whose benefit is chiefly emotional.
changed_reading.after: A live covenantal reading appears: carrying God's remembered claim like a retained deed keeps obligations connected, and that integrity gives the heart security.

context_deltas.mechanism: Self-restraint under distress precedes a greeting of safety and peace. This sequence makes heart-settling a cultivated temporal capacity whose outcome is peace, rather than an instant feeling available without endurance.

activation_trace.role: Holding the self back from panic supplies the practiced capacity underlying repose.
Freedom from harm supplies the mature condition reached through patient continuity.
The repeated patience cue explicitly links that peaceful outcome to sustained restraint.
Focus repose becomes a trained stability continuous with patience and peace.
Recurring reminders provide the repeated support by which restraint is maintained.

structural_cues: 13:22's root د ر ء at word 13 has no branch inventory and is used only as the structural act of meeting harm with good.
13:24 explicitly places peace and patience in a causal-looking sequence, while 13:28 repeats the means of settling.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies restraint, a branchless harm-countering cue, peace, and repeated remembrance; I infer a temporal arrow from practiced restraint through recollection to settled safety. The alternative is that peace is solely a later reward and not a present mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Remembrance produces immediate calm independently of practice or conduct.
changed_reading.after: Remembrance sustains a patient capacity to resist disintegration; tranquility is practiced over time and can mature into lived peace.

context_deltas.mechanism: The nearby joy in proximate life is bounded as temporary utility, separating tranquility from mere pleasant excitement. The focus affect is stable orientation, not simply a more religious instance of exhilaration.

activation_trace.role: Expanded delight supplies the positive affect that might otherwise be confused with tranquility.
Exultant excess exposes how pleasant feeling can become unstable through its object.
The proximate-world branch limits the horizon of the delight under critique.
Enjoyable utility marks the delight as real yet bounded, rather than durable orientation.
Repose supplies the more durable affective structure distinguished from excitement.
Security locates tranquility in trusted orientation rather than intensity of pleasure.

structural_cues: 13:26 qualifies worldly life as utility, then 13:27-28 turn to guidance, return, faith, and settled hearts.
The focus uses repose vocabulary rather than the joy vocabulary just used nearby.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies nearby delight tied to proximate utility and then secure repose; I infer a semantic boundary between excitement and orientation. The alternative is that only the object of joy is criticized, so wholesome joy may still accompany tranquility.

changed_reading.before: Tranquility is simply a pleasant religious emotion.
changed_reading.after: Pleasant emotion may accompany it, but tranquility is the more durable security of a Godward orientation and cannot be measured by exhilaration alone.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus is followed immediately by faith expressed as deliberate fitting action and good return, then by reliance and return toward God. Tranquility is therefore a hinge from inner orientation into work, trust, and renewed homecoming.

activation_trace.role: The repeated faith cue carries the focus's inward assent directly into the next verse.
Deliberate action supplies an outward consequence rather than leaving repose self-enclosed.
Fitness to its purpose makes the resulting action congruent with settled orientation.
Return to a homeward destination extends the reorientation process beyond the immediate feeling.
Reliant trust supplies the posture by which settled orientation becomes durable conduct.
Focus assent is the inward side of the same faith-action sequence.
Repose functions as a hinge state that releases coherent action rather than terminating movement.

structural_cues: 13:29 repeats the opening description of 13:28 and immediately adds action, then closes with return.
13:30 adds reliance and another return expression, extending the focus sequence outward and forward.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated faith, purposeful action, fittingness, return, and reliance around the focus; I infer that tranquility enables coherent action and homeward movement. The alternative is a simple list of believer traits without a process arrow.

changed_reading.before: The verse ends in an inward state valued for its own sake.
changed_reading.after: The settled heart is a hinge: restored orientation becomes fitting work and reliant movement toward a good return.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later garden's continuing fruit activates both stillness and duration in one branch. Focus tranquility can thus be read as an inhabitable pattern of provision and shade, not a brief peak experience.

activation_trace.role: The fusion of stillness with continuance gives tranquility temporal depth.
Calming a boil supplies a process image in which agitation subsides without the vessel disappearing.
Focus repose receives the later branch's durative rather than episodic profile.
Repeated reminders supply the maintenance by which the settled pattern continues.

structural_cues: 13:35 surrounds continuing fruit with flowing rivers and shade, forming a sustained environment rather than an isolated instant.
The focus's internal repetition already gives its repose a renewable rhythm.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies continued provision, a branch combining duration with stillness, and repeated focus remembrance; I infer that remembrance maintains a durable inner habitat. The alternative is that the garden's duration belongs only to future reward.

changed_reading.before: Tranquility is an intense but episodic devotional experience.
changed_reading.after: Tranquility is renewable habitation: repeated remembrance maintains a durable interior climate in which agitation can subside and provision can continue.

context_deltas.mechanism: Erasure and establishment beside the book activate remembrance as selective reinscription. What can fade is repeatedly restored across heart and tongue, so settling becomes continuity of identity under revision rather than resistance to every change.

activation_trace.role: Loss of an imprint supplies the vulnerability against which remembrance works.
Durable establishment supplies the counter-movement to erasure.
Explicit stability across heart, intellect, and tongue directly links establishment to the focus faculties.
Ordered writing gives the erasure-establishment contrast an inscription medium.
Recovery after forgetting supplies repeated reinscription at the focus level.
Tongued mention joins the context branch that stabilizes both heart and speech.
Repose is the continuity produced when a defining orientation is repeatedly restored.

structural_cues: 13:39 coordinates erasing and establishing in one antithesis and immediately names the book.
13:28 doubles remembrance and distributes the resulting repose across two parallel clauses.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies erased trace, establishment explicitly spanning heart and tongue, writing, and restorative recollection; I infer that repeated remembrance preserves orientation through selective reinscription. The alternative is that 13:39 concerns divine decree alone and offers no interior analogue.

changed_reading.before: A settled heart is one protected from revision or loss.
changed_reading.after: A settled heart can undergo erasure and change while its defining Godward orientation is repeatedly re-established in attention, speech, and memory.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it combines two physical side-branches rather than the dominant affective senses; it remains anchored in the focus's repeated roots for settling and heart, but downstream prose should mark it as an embodied spatial metaphor, not claim that the verse lexically means lowering an organ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The two occurrences of the settling verb flank two occurrences of the turnable heart noun.

activation_trace.role: Physical lowering supplies a descent of the heart's center of gravity.
Turning from face to face supplies the unstable body whose orientation is lowered and steadied.
Repeated prompting supplies the action that renews the lowered posture.

changed_reading.before: Tranquility is only an abstract emotional state.
changed_reading.after: As an embodied co-reading, remembrance lowers the center of gravity of a flipping heart, making it harder for each new pressure to overturn the whole person.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it crosses from judgment's rein and inclination's fall into cardiac regulation; it remains anchored by the focus heart's turning and settling branches plus the explicit 13:37 opposition between judgment and inclinations. Render only as an exploratory control-system analogy, with the ordinary guidance reading left fully live.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus heart can turn and can take a lowered posture; 13:37 supplies a rein image and downward or inclinational vectors.

activation_trace.role: The rein supplies a material governor that redirects motion without abolishing it.
Downward falling supplies the dangerous vector against which the heart is governed.
Inward inclination identifies desire as the moving force rather than an external projectile.
The reversible heart supplies the steerable element.
A lowered posture supplies stability against runaway descent.
Recollection supplies the recurring feedback signal that corrects the vector.

changed_reading.before: Remembrance comforts desire after it has chosen a direction.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, remembrance acts like feedback through a rein: it detects the turn toward a falling inclination, redirects the heart, and lowers it into a stable course.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the right-document branch of remembrance is rare and the witness-book cues are later; it remains valid as a cross-ayah activation grounded in exact focus and context branches. Qualify it as an evidentiary overlay on recollection, not a replacement definition of remembrance.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus repeats remembrance of God and links it to secure faith and the heart's core.

activation_trace.role: A document preserving a claim supplies the latent deed-like form of remembrance.
The pure core supplies the interior place where the claim is retained.
A protected covenant supplies the claim that the inner deed records.
Sufficiency closes the need for endless external corroboration.
Knowledgeable testimony gives the retained claim evidentiary force.
Binding inscription makes the covenant record consequential rather than decorative.

changed_reading.before: Heart-settling rests only on a subjective feeling of presence.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, repeated remembrance carries an interior deed of the divine claim; covenant, sufficient witness, and binding record quiet the heart by giving its orientation evidentiary weight.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is the most material and branch-remote reading because it activates the mold branch behind the heart root; it remains anchored in a focus root and is independently checked by the later strengthening cue. Render as a carefully flagged formation analogy, never as the surface sense of hearts.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The heart root has a mold branch, while focus repetition and later establishment can describe repeated formation.

activation_trace.role: A casting form supplies the material image of an interior receiving stable shape.
Repeated prompting supplies successive impressions rather than one irreversible cast.
Active strengthening supplies the hardening or reinforcement of the received form.

changed_reading.before: Remembrance merely soothes a heart whose shape is already fixed.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, repeated remembrance helps cast and reinforce the heart's form; tranquility is the stability of an orientation being repeatedly shaped.

strongest_changes: The immediate return cue revises tranquility from stasis into recurrent Godward reorientation of a turnable heart.
The stream-and-foam sequence recasts repose as selective retention: disturbance can keep moving while useful orientation remains.
The covenant, inscription, and witness branches activate a legal-evidentiary reading in which remembrance secures the heart by retaining a binding claim.
The contrast with proximate joy weakens any equation of tranquility with pleasant intensity, while the following action and return strengthen its practical output.
summary.what_was_special: The focus's mirrored repetition supported several simultaneous mechanisms rather than one final interpretation: secure assent, attentional re-presence, voiced naming, affect containment, material filtering, covenant continuity, durable practice, and exploratory spatial or formative analogies.
remaining_uncertainties: The text strongly links remembrance and settling, but the trace cannot determine whether remembrance initiates repose, maintains it, or names a reciprocal loop with prior faith.
The voiced, covenant-document, rein, lowering, and mold readings are branch-grounded but remain secondary overlays whose prose must preserve their exploratory status.
The water, garden, and erase-establish transfers may describe cosmic or eschatological processes first and inner psychology only by reader-supplied analogy.
